events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi, I'm Maria Alvarez. March 14th, 1968. I need my lisinopril .
Thanks, one moment while I check.
I can send a request about this recorded medication, lisinopril ten milligram tablets, one tablet once a day, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
Actually, it's for my husband, Theo Lindquist, born November 2nd, 1979. His metformin? Yes. Send it. I'm sure .
I need to verify your husband before I can look up or request his medicine. Please confirm his full name and date of birth.
Thanks, one moment while I check.
I can send a request about this recorded medication, metformin five hundred milligram tablets, one tablet twice a day with meals, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
